Messages.Body:
If I play a master and it is suddenly reversed, is that it for my
master phase? Or can I play another master?

Messages.Author: Gord Culleton
Messages.Body:


Well, the DTR says that Sudden Reversal hoses Giant's Blood,
and still disallows anyone else from playing it (only one GB
per game), so if your Master card gets Sudden Reversed, your
Master phase is done. (Unless Anson or Rumors of Gehenna are out)

Jere Culleton
(Rush Rules!!!)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Gord Culleton <bg...@FreeNet.Carleton.CA> wrote:
>Well, the DTR says that Sudden Reversal hoses Giant's Blood,
>and still disallows anyone else from playing it (only one GB
>per game), so if your Master card gets Sudden Reversed, your
>Master phase is done. (Unless Anson or Rumors of Gehenna are out)

Using an out-of-turn card burns your next master phase, not your next
master action. Anson and Rumors won't let you play two out-of-turn cards
between turns, won't let you play another if one gets Sudden Reversed, etc.
They are just providing master actions, not master phases.
